snippet.title: The Last Faith: Awakened Ancients DLC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Awakened Ancients, the first DLC for The Last Faith, is available now on PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One and PC.*

Are you ready to step once more into its merciless world?

Within Awakened Ancients, new trials and deeper mysteries await.

Take up your journey again through New Game+, Dungeon Mode, Boss Rush Mode, and Tower of Despair. Experience all-new executions, gameplay improvements, new selectable characters, items and weapons.

And as promised… Awakened Ancients is completely free, as a gesture of gratitude for your unwavering support.

The world of The Last Faith has awakened once more. Step forward, traveler, its ancient shadows are waiting for you.

The Nintendo Switch release has been hit with an unexpected delay and will be released as soon as possible. We will keep you posted when it becomes available.

This free DLC content requires the base game in order to play. Some regions and platforms do not allow for free content and the DLC will be listed for the minimum monetary amount possible in those cases.
